label: Knowledge Workbench
headline: Overview route is live; knowledge delivery remains module-gated
summary: This overview is a truthful landing surface for the Knowledge Workbench. It exposes the remaining browse, evidence, and versioning contracts without pretending that the full registry, notes, or evidence browser are already live.

packet_family.note: KW-01 Institutional Memory browse module is ready. KW-02 to KW-05 remain blocked on net-new BFF routes or lifecycle contracts.

modules.label: Institutional Memory
modules.summary: Browse/list/detail projection published. Identity, lifecycle state machine, filter rail, and degradation semantics are all locked via docs/bff/KW-01-institutional-memory.md.
modules.next_gate: KW-02 note ownership and attachment contract must be published before Research Notes UI can open.

modules.label: Research Notes
modules.summary: Note create/list/detail flows and the attachment taxonomy are still undefined at the BFF layer.
missing_contracts: Research note ownership and attachment contract
modules.next_gate: Publish note attachment and ownership truth after KW-01 identity settles.

modules.label: Evidence Refs
modules.summary: Evidence browse/detail projections and typed link resolution are not yet available as workbench routes.
modules.next_gate: Publish typed evidence-link truth after memory anchors and note source context are stable.

modules.label: Insight Cards
modules.summary: Insight aggregation and filter semantics still live only in backlog language; no workbench packet exists yet.
modules.next_gate: Publish card identity and linked-source drilldown after memory and evidence routes are live.

modules.label: Strategy Spec
modules.summary: Canonical StrategySpec objects exist, but there is still no browse/detail/version compare workbench projection.
modules.next_gate: Publish versioned browse truth and diff semantics after lineage and evidence anchors are stable.
